        This file contains death records from the Bessarabian villages
        of South Russia for the period 1850-1859.
        This information was compiled by R. Reuben Drefs, coordinator and
        volunteers La Rose Ketterling, Le Roy Dockter and Darlene Drefs from
        the St. Petersburg Lutheran Evangelical archives published by the LDS.
        Edited by Marty McMahon.
